core_meaning.primary_meaning: Naureen corresponds to the Arabic form نُورِين and is glossed in this record as “Light, luminous.” The lexical gloss describes the word-form; Qur’anic occurrence, religious recommendation, popularity, and a name-bearer’s character are separate claims and are not established by this gloss alone.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Naureen corresponds to the Arabic form نُورِين (Arabic نُور (nūr) + feminine ending). Its core sense is naureen; light, luminous. Naureen is Arabic نُورِين (Nūrīn) 'light, luminous', from نُور (nūr) 'light'. The source gloss 'Light, Pleasing' is broadly consistent.
